# Vendored Box3D

This directory contains the Box3D v0.1.0 core library from
https://github.com/erincatto/box3d at commit
`8441b4a06d6d09dcfb0b0f704df4d847d1437b92`.

Only the public headers, core C sources, and upstream license are vendored.
Nano Script's adapter is implemented separately in `lib/src/dynamic.c`.

Box3D is Copyright (c) 2026 Erin Catto and distributed under the MIT license;
see `LICENSE` in this directory.
